_: The herald (news_chips.gd; Theme Hospital's announcer, Stronghold's scribe): one notice on screen at a time, the rest wait their turn in order instead of being written over, and the plain refusals get a dry voice. on: the switch (or --herald=on). queue: notices kept waiting at most (the oldest goes). min_read: seconds a notice stays before the next may take its place. voices: a notice that starts with 'starts' may get one of 'say' in place of that start (the rest of the line kept), or one of 'whole' in place of the line, with chance (a dry line where it lands, never on every notice; Mac: professional, nothing gimmicky).

whole: That petitioner has already gone home.

voices.starts: The doors of the court close
whole: The court rises. The realm moves again.
